name: GivenWhenLab
description: An open-source lab exploring behavior-driven development, test automation, and the research behind better software tests.
scope: GivenWhenLab connects research and practice in Behavior-Driven Development, Gherkin, automated testing, empirical software engineering, developer tools, and experiments with AI applied to software testing.
disclaimer: Independent open-source initiative. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Cucumber project.
